- **Windows setup:** installs both games per user without administrator rights and sets up the game data from your own
  installation (Steam, EA app, Origin or disc). Available with and without the free ground, road and tree textures.
- **Graphics:** the High and Very high detail levels now use the newer effects (soft and cascaded shadows, water
  reflections, temporal anti-aliasing, per-pixel lighting of models, height fog; Very high also ambient occlusion,
  contact shadows and light shafts). Fixed: dynamic lights were placed slightly off, stripes with TAA together with HDR
  and bloom.
- **Menus:** options, skirmish and LAN menus reworked for large and wide screens (3440x1440): the zoom choice in LAN
  games is back, drop-down lists stay on the screen, values and buttons are centred, shorter labels instead of shrunken
  text, missing Generals texts added. Screenshots now include menus and the command bar.
- **Start-up:** the release build no longer quits silently at start (a leftover of EA's copy protection), a missing
  music file no longer ends the game, and a language in the settings without matching game data falls back instead of
  stopping the start. File names outside Latin-1 (replays, crash reports, screenshots) work.
- **Game data:** `PatchINI.big` of the digital releases is left out like the other archives of their "custom mission"
  menu entry. The English EA app version has been checked as data source.
- **Wide screens:** the camera reaches the whole map, also after rotating it and on maps whose edges lie lower than the
  centre; the radar frame matches the view. Generals Challenge load and score screens, their background video and the
  menu frame of the skirmish and online menus stay centred. Superweapon timers move down beside the command bar.
- **Effects:** the ECM tank's disabling beam and the ground light of particle effects (muzzle flashes, fire) flicker much less.
- **Stability:** texture mipmaps are built without WIC (suspected cause of a crash on one computer); a clear message
  instead of EA's generic error when the game data is missing, with an offer to run the setup.
